<thought>To propose a single‑step retrosynthesis that is the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction, I need a template that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl group and a C‑C double bond, and forms a ketone (C=O). I will search the template catalog for such a transformation applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
